title: SpatialMemory
description: EEG dataset investigating visuo-spatial working memory (VSWM) for sequences during a computerized spatial span task in younger and older healthy adults. The study examines whether theta and gamma oscillatory dynamics reflect item-level sequence encoding and recall, and how these processes change in healthy cognitive aging. Results indicate that later gamma power during encoding and theta-gamma phase amplitude coupling during recall track serial position, and may be preserved with aging.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a computerized spatial span task. Participants encoded and recalled sequences of spatial locations while oscillatory activity in the theta and gamma frequency bands was recorded. Analysis focused on item-level neural dynamics during both encoding and recall phases, with examination of gamma band power and theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling across serial positions.
